title: Iceberg FILE and VECTOR

items: Proposal review for multimodal lakehouse architecture
GitHub status checked October 23, 2026
API, table semantics, and physical encoding have separate readiness boundaries

note: 这组内容是设计提案与 PR，不是论文，也不是已稳定发版的能力。

title: Verified proposal status
note: API 响应核查显示三者均未形成稳定产品承诺。状态以后会变化，日期是本次快照。

title: FILE represents a byte range

items: The proposed FILE type can reference bytes inline or in an external file.
It defines a distinct nested type and TypeID instead of inheriting struct semantics.
The submitted API change forms one part of a broader FILE support sequence.

note: 读取图片或音视频片段需要字节范围的结构语义。API 类型存在并不代表所有 engine 的读写、GC 和权限已经实现。

title: Derived nested field IDs protect schema evolution

items: Six nested fields derive their IDs from the containing FILE field ID.
ID assignment reserves the derived block against future columns.
Visitors receive dedicated FILE handling with a default struct fallback where appropriate.

note: 类型系统必须防止 schema evolution 与内部字段 ID 冲突。普通 struct visitor 的兼容回退也需要逐个检查语义。

title: Version gating constrains rollout

items: The FILE PR gates the proposed type to format version 4.
Older table versions cannot silently acquire the new semantics.
Reader, writer, schema evolution, and table upgrade support need independent verification.

note: 版本门槛保护兼容性。不能因为格式规范拟新增一个类型就宣称现有 Spark/Trino 环境均可使用。

title: Iceberg VECTOR specifies shape intent

items: The issue proposes a primitive fixed-size numeric vector type.
Embedding dimension belongs in schema semantics rather than only application conventions.
The current Iceberg issue points to Parquet proposal #624.

note: 重要修正：给定阅读列表中的 Parquet #592 并非 issue 当前指向的唯一方案。不要把两个提案当成已经达成一致的最终规范。

title: Parquet #592 changes repetition semantics

items: The draft adds a VECTOR logical type and VECTOR repetition type.
SchemaElement.vector_length fixes the number of element slots per vector occurrence.
The VECTOR repetition level adds no definition or repetition level of its own.

note: 这是物理编码层面的新语义，不能把普通 LIST 写入后仅更名就当作兼容实现。

title: Nullability and reader behavior in #592

rows: Writers should keep one vector within a data page

note: 这些是 #592 草案的具体选择，不保证最终标准采纳。兼容性测试需覆盖 null vector、null element、空值与页边界。

title: Prototypes provide limited performance evidence

items: The draft links alternative Arrow prototypes and an Arrow Go proof of concept.
Microbenchmarks motivate avoiding variable-list machinery for fixed shapes.
No integrated Iceberg multi-engine production benchmark appears in these proposal bodies.

note: 本 deck 不将提案链接中的微基准扩写为端到端训练吞吐增益，也没有执行任何原型。

title: Storage types leave indexing policy open

items: Inference: a vector field still needs model version and distance-metric metadata.
Inference: FILE references need lifecycle rules that protect external objects across snapshots.
Proposed application: keep logical schema adoption separate from ANN index publication.

note: 类型支持不自动提供 ANN、跨表事务或外部文件垃圾回收。以上是工程设计要求，不是 PR 已交付内容。

title: A compatibility-first evaluation matrix

items: Test round trips across intended writers and readers at exact version pins.
Test dimension mismatch, nulls, nested fields, field-ID evolution, and unsupported readers.
For FILE, test overwrite, snapshot retention, external authorization, and orphan cleanup.

note: 可以先在隔离样例数据上验证格式能力，避免升级真实训练表后才发现某个 engine 无法读取。

title: Adoption boundary

items: Published state: FILE API work and VECTOR proposals remain open.
Inference: the main risk lies in coordinated format and engine support.
Proposed gate: wait for agreed spec and supported releases before production schema migration.

note: 关注 Apache 评审、最终规范、release note 和跨引擎测试四条证据线。静态阅读与状态核查不等于集成验证。
